limitations: Rows distinguish PSP-simultaneous and standalone balance (BL) measurements
CD is N/A for PSP-simultaneous records and must remain null, not imputed

measurement_channels.definition: RMS strain-gauge signal at alpha divided by RMS signal at zero-lift alpha=-0.8 degrees
limitations: Buffet-onset indicator only; not a full structural mode or deformation measurement
ESP point coordinates and Kulite matching IDs are to be read from the acquired CSV headers
PSD files are sensor-specific; mapping must use the paired ESP sensor-location file
The JAXA page flags the approximately 9 kHz PSD peak as wind-tunnel noise
Reliability masks exclude sensor lines, markers and edge regions
Camera exposure introduces low-pass filtering; uPSP RMS must not be equated directly to Kulite RMS
No official distributed deformation or modal time-history measurement is currently published on the JAXA page

measurement_operator_requirements: Bind each instrument family to its own calibration, sampling, spatial mapping, transfer function and uncertainty
Do not merge ESP, Kulite and uPSP samples as though they are co-located/co-bandwidth observations
Do not infer simultaneous time synchronization between balance, strain gauge, Kulite and uPSP without source metadata
Do not remove or reinterpret the approximately 9 kHz wind-tunnel noise feature as a physical structural resonance without independent evidence
Preserve raw measurement values and masks; any filtering/correction is a separate source-bound transformation
Do not inherit the DPW8 Test Case 2 Welch sampling/window/PSD settings into Test Case 3

spectral_processing.explicit_non_inheritance: Do not copy Test Case 2 PSD processing settings into this Test Case 3 dataset without source evidence.

data_format_observations.container_format: Tecplot-readable ASCII templates are used for workshop submissions
data_format_observations.normalization_note: The AIAA change log states version 3 reports deflection normalized by reference semi-span
data_format_observations.admission_note: Read the actual template and preserve its columns, units, coordinates and missing-value semantics before implementing an importer

dynamic_measurement_operator_policy.ESP: time-averaged point-pressure coefficient; use its CSV for sensor locations and numbering
dynamic_measurement_operator_policy.Kulite: unsteady point-pressure RMS and sensor-specific PSD; link by sensor ID to the ESP coordinate CSV
dynamic_measurement_operator_policy.uPSP: surface-pressure mean/RMS/PSD/snapshots mapped to jig shape; retain masks and camera-exposure low-pass transfer limitations
dynamic_measurement_operator_policy.wing_root_strain_gauge: derived buffet-intensity coefficient normalized by the zero-lift RMS at alpha=-0.8 degrees
dynamic_measurement_operator_policy.balance: preserve PSP-simultaneous vs standalone BL provenance; PSP-simultaneous CD remains unavailable
dynamic_measurement_operator_policy.structural_deformation: official distributed deformation measurements pending; preliminary 10-12 mm at alpha=4.7 degrees is qualitative only

dynamic_spectral_cautions: JAXA identifies the approximately 9 kHz Kulite PSD peak as wind-tunnel noise; do not call it a structural mode without independent evidence
uPSP camera exposure introduces low-pass filtering; uPSP RMS and Kulite RMS are not directly interchangeable
Do not inherit Test Case 2 Welch/PSD sampling settings for Test Case 3 without source evidence
Do not assume common time synchronization across balance, strain gauge, Kulite and uPSP
data_format_observations.dynamic_fsi_claim_limit: The JAXA page reports official deformation measurements are pending; this dataset supports pressure/buffet and dynamic-method studies, but not a complete measured dynamic wing deformation validation.
